correctness.rationale: Frobenius normal n(t)=u_perp u_perp^T and the chosen two orthonormal symmetric tangent frame vectors plus skew A yield continuous coefficient ODE a′=sqrt(2)b,b′=−sqrt(2)a. Next-plane projections give B_N with trace (1+3cosδ)/2 and determinant (1+cosδ)/2=cos²(pi/N); discriminant (cosδ−1)(9cosδ+7)/4 is negative for N>=3. Cayley–Hamilton supplies B_N^N and determinant-one scaled singular values; no common nonzero symmetric vector lies in all tangent planes, so strict contraction follows. Taylor expansions rho^N=1−pi²/(2N)+O(N^-2), Ntheta=sqrt(2)pi+O(N^-2), v/omega=pi/(2sqrt(2)N)+O(N^-3) lead to the exact norm coefficient. Independent matrix computation checked spectrum, singular values and asymptotic limit over small/large meshes. N=3 handled; no nonhomogeneous equation asserted.
